dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Well, the grass here isn't as soft as the spot where I usually take my afternoon nap.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: There aren't as many butterflies here as in the meadow I like to go to.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: And I can't hunt freely here like out in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll... look into making some improvements.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: But... there's no smell of alcohol hanging in the air here...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...And no drunkards kicking up a fuss.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: So... I think we can keep it the way it is...
